name: paper-to-blog
description: Create source-faithful blog articles and conference posters from research papers supplied as local PDFs or arXiv URLs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn papers into blog posts and conference posters.
interface.longDescription: Paper to Blog includes paper-to-blog for accessible HTML articles and paper-to-poster for visual conference research posters. Both accept local PDFs or arXiv links and preserve the paper’s evidence, figures, and limitations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF or arXiv paper into a clear, source-faithful blog version.
